sessionStart.command: /bin/sh -c 'PATH="${XDG_BIN_HOME:-$HOME/.local/bin}:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:${PATH:-}"; export PATH; env YOKE_ROOT="${CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}" YOKE_EXECUTOR=cursor YOKE_HOOK_CONFIG_OWNER=cursor-project yoke hook evaluate SessionStart'

sessionEnd.command: /bin/sh -c 'PATH="${XDG_BIN_HOME:-$HOME/.local/bin}:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:${PATH:-}"; export PATH; root=""; for c in "$YOKE_ROOT" "$CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR" "$PWD"; do [ -n "$c" ] && [ -d "$c" ] && root="$c" && break; done; if [ -z "$root" ]; then for c in "$CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR" "$YOKE_ROOT"; do case "$c" in */.worktrees/*|*/.claude/worktrees/*) p="${c%%/.worktrees/*}"; p="${p%%/.claude/worktrees/*}"; [ -d "$p" ] && root="$p" && break;; esac; done; fi; [ -n "$root" ] || root="${HOME:-/tmp}"; cd "$root" 2>/dev/null || cd "${HOME:-/tmp}" 2>/dev/null || cd /; env YOKE_ROOT="$root" YOKE_EXECUTOR=cursor YOKE_CURSOR_LIFECYCLE_ROOT=1 YOKE_HOOK_CONFIG_OWNER=cursor-project yoke hook evaluate SessionEnd'
